wholePhysicalScope: The official UniSQ campus plan identifies Building X as Blair Pavilion. It provides the approximate 56-metre roof outline, aligned using campus map scale and two named OpenStreetMap control buildings. The named controls establish site registration only.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain the long pavilion, hipped roof, five ventilators and open veranda. The nearer levels add window bars, treads and steel rails.
limitations: Exterior represents the photographed Blair Pavilion at the former Ipswich Mental Hospital site. Other hospital buildings and interiors are outside the model.
The location and footprint derive from an approximately registered university campus plan. Window details, roof junctions and rear elevations are estimated.
The original terrain is preserved. Veranda and exterior stair footing heights remain approximate.
